title: Birds Birds Birds | Kids Song & Nursery Rhymes for Toddlers | BuBu TV - English
description:
A cheerful bird song for little ones that celebrates flying high, tiny chicks and the sweet sounds of tweet, tweet.
Perfect for toddlers and preschoolers learning animals, colors and simple words.
Sing along and wave your arms like wings!

Birds, birds, flying high
Parrot's green and sparrow's sky
Pecking seeds and sweet fruit too
Hop, hop, hop, and peck-a-peck-a-boo

Nest so warm with eggs in a row
Little chicks go cheep, cheep, oh!
Kids bring grains for every bird
Sing, sing, sing, the birds have heard

Birds, birds, flying high
Sing a song and say goodbye

Parrot talks to baby dear
Tweet, tweet, come and hear!
Fly, fly, fly up in the sky
Little birds are happy, bye-bye!

Birds, birds, flying high
Sing a song and say goodbye

Mum says hello, tweet, tweet, hi!
Birds, birds, flying high
